# Plot a Newton-Raphson step

Draws the log-likelihood from
[`newton_raphson_rasch()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemirt/reference/newton_raphson_rasch.md)
with its last step: the estimate the step starts from (red dot), the
tangent to the log-likelihood there (blue line), the estimate the step
ends at (green dot) and the triangle between the tangent and the
horizontal axis, whose angle is zero at the maximum.

## Usage

``` r
plot_newton_raphson(nr)
```

## Arguments

- nr:

  Result of
  [`newton_raphson_rasch()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemirt/reference/newton_raphson_rasch.md).

## Value

A `plotly` object.

## Examples

``` r
plot_newton_raphson(newton_raphson_rasch(response_pattern(2), iterations = 2))
```
